name: SPEC-P-012 counterexample: the probe exits 1 for an item that does not hold the tutorial release
summary: Falsifier check for SPEC-P-012 ('the tutorial plan final release item has no blocker on this plan P-010'). Run on WI-10006876 (this plan's P-003), which has no blocks edge onto WI-10004839, the probe reported edges=0 and exited 1. The probe therefore distinguishes a held release from an unheld one.
scope: Read-only query of the operator database on the dev host, run in host context (sudo -n -u postgres psql). Nothing was changed.
oracle: The persisted dependency rows for WI-10006876 (blocks WI-10006878 and WI-10006880 only), read directly from harness_shared.work_item_deps.
